assertions.evidence_text: A profit-sharing, stock bonus, pre-ERISA money purchase pension, or rural cooperative plan does not fail to satisfy the requirements of section 401(a) merely because the plan includes a cash or deferred arrangement.
assertions.rationale: The operative rule says a profit-sharing plan does not fail section 401(a) merely because it includes a cash or deferred arrangement, affirming satisfaction despite that arrangement.

assertions.evidence_text: The assessment rate will remain in effect indefinitely unless modified, suspended, or terminated.
assertions.rationale: The assessment rate is stated to remain in effect indefinitely, subject to the express condition that it is not modified, suspended, or terminated.

assertions.evidence_text: It’s beyond my understanding why the FCC would think that our local ABC station does not provide a service to our communities.
assertions.rationale: The filing author's rhetorical rejection of the FCC's contrary view affirms that the local ABC station provides community service; the speaker is not named in the excerpt.
